prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, Night, warm interior downlights.
Image 1: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Lu Shaoze stands at the elevator end of the autumn landscape painting, facing Ji Ran with a stiffened smile. Ji Ran stands at the front-door end of the painting, facing him with a cold smirk, the black handbag on her arm. The elevator doors have closed behind them. The camera stays in front of the painting wall.
Panel 1: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran onto Lu Shaoze, eye-level. Lu Shaoze recovers his grin and leans in toward Ji Ran, hands in his trouser pockets.
Panel 2: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Ji Ran. Ji Ran's smirk drops and her jaw sets.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, low angle on Lu Shaoze, slight push in. Lu Shaoze tilts his head with a mocking, superior look.
Panel 4: Extreme close-up insert, locked-off camera, on the handbag strap. Ji Ran's fingers tighten hard around the strap of the black handbag, her knuckles going pale.
Panel 5: Close-up, slow push in on Ji Ran's eyes, eye-level. Ji Ran's eyes redden and glisten. She draws a sharp breath and swallows her anger.
Panel 6: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Lu Shaoze onto Ji Ran, eye-level. Ji Ran looks straight at him, her voice steady.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, low angle on Ji Ran, handheld. Ji Ran takes half a step toward him, her chin raised and her eyes hard.
Panel 8: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze's grin widens smugly, then flickers as she goes on.
Panel 9: Medium shot, eye-level two-shot beneath the painting, slow push in on Ji Ran. Ji Ran flips her hair back over her shoulder and announces it with cool confidence while Lu Shaoze freezes.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
